SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices AS i JOIN invoice_details AS id ON i.invoice_id = id.invoice_id JOIN drink_details AS dd ON id.drink_detail_id = dd.drink_detail_id JOIN drinks AS d ON dd.drink_id = d.drink_id JOIN shops AS s ON i.shop_id = s.shop_id JOIN profiles AS p ON i.profile_id = p.profile_id LEFT JOIN shop_tables AS st ON i.table_id = st.table_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(id.unit_price * id.quantity), 0) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_id) AS total_invoices FROM invoices AS i JOIN invoice_details AS id ON i.invoice_id = id.invoice_id JOIN drink_details AS dd ON id.drink_detail_id = dd.drink_detail_id JOIN drinks AS d ON dd.drink_id = d.drink_id JOIN shops AS s ON i.shop_id = s.shop_id JOIN profiles AS p ON i.profile_id = p.profile_id LEFT JOIN shop_tables AS st ON i.table_id = st.table_id
